patch_description: Reserve one LP evaluation in each batch for a structurally novel network. The current batch selector fills all nine slots with surrogate-ranked moves before its tail-exploration code can run, so it effectively lacks a dedicated novelty evaluation. This change keeps up to eight slots for energy-favored proposals, then uses the final slot for the fresh proposal whose nearest archive member is farthest away, breaking ties by surrogate energy. That gives occasional exploration of distinct topologies without sacrificing most exploitation.
